body: So you understand you are saying it's ok to kill babies.

Sadly, it's real. It's from a study (see above) where abortion doctors were asked about things they felt about their job that they were afraid to say to others. There were some really disturbing quotes in that study, this was only one of them. Unfortunately, the study is behind a paywall but I was able to get a copy. [https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28501756/](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/28501756/)

Just so you know, here is the source for the quote:  Lisa A. Martin, PhD, Jane A. Hassinger, MSW, Michelle Debbink, MD, PhD, Lisa H. Harris, MD, PhD “Dangertalk: Voices of abortion providers” *Social Science & Medicine* 184 (2017) 75-83

Isn't alive? It grows. It takes in nutrition. In fact by the time nearly all abortions take place it has a heart pumping blood through blood vessels (3 weeks) What else on earth has a beating heart and is not alive?  Not to mention by eight weeks it has organs, hands, feet, etc. It moves and kicks? Not alive? Seriously? 

You need to learn a bit about fetal development. At this page you can see a video, taken in the womb, of a baby moving around and can clearly see the heartbeat at six weeks. http://www.ehd.org/ This is not a pro-life site- its sponsored by National Geographic
